title: Structure, when the repo can't be built
question: In the web-app repository, what does the function run() (in src/main.ts) call? For each call, say where the called function is defined.
answer_key:
Same as T1: run() (web-app/src/main.ts line 4) calls render (web-app/src/render.ts line 1) and hello (npm package greet-lib, greet-lib repo src/index.ts line 1).
In this world web-app has no package.json or tsconfig, so it has no compiler index.
Scoring: both calls with definitions = correct; one = partial; none = wrong.
lesson: The syntax graph works on code that can't be built; the compiler index has nothing for it.
plain: Same question, but the web app can't be built (no build config), so it can't be compiled.
